_comment: Example operator declaration for core_readiness.py --manifest (spec/CORE_COMM.md, R). Every value below is a placeholder the operator replaces from the running rig and then reviews; the file must be owned by root or the caller and not group/world writable (UNTRUSTED_DECLARATION otherwise). The declaration states what the operator expects; core_readiness.py reports READY only when both status sockets, the gateway probe and the driver container agree with it twice in a row. It is topology and input readiness, never observed physical execution.

components.exe_sha256: <sha256 of the gate executable inside the gate container: docker exec pailhw-gate sha256sum /proc/1/exe>
components.config_generation: <config_generation reported by the gate status socket>

safe.node_name: <subscriber node of the safe command topic (motion bridge)>

permit.node_name: <subscriber node of the permit topic (motion bridge)>

components.exe_sha256: <sha256 of the bridge executable inside the bridge container: docker exec pailhw-bridge sha256sum /proc/1/exe>
components.config_generation: <config_generation reported by the bridge status socket>

safe.node_name: <publisher node of the safe command topic (gate)>

drive.node_name: <subscriber node of the drive topic (base driver)>

gateway.probe_sha256: <sha256 of that binary on this host>
